rationale: The replication successfully reproduces the central Landau-theory phenomenology: the coupled iCDW-rCDW free energy yields exactly two generic mixed phases (3Q-3Q and 2Q-1Q), pure iCDW is excluded as a standalone minimum, and 2Q-1Q breaks C3 symmetry. However, the paper's scope extends well beyond this Landau core—it includes DFT electronic structure calculations, group-theoretic derivation of seven distinct iCDW irreps from VHS symmetry content, classification of subsidiary magnetic orders (ferromagnetic, octupolar, toroidal, monopolar), SOC-induced SDW, and magneto-response properties. These constitute roughly half the paper's testable claims and were explicitly skipped. The Landau minimization uses chosen (not derived) coefficients, demonstrating qualitative phase selection but not quantitative material-specific predictions.
